items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: Then we joined Charlie Elger in Milwaukee.

ctx.x: On the alto sax. The three joined us in St. Louis. And from there we went to New York. We stayed around New York, what, a month, a couple of months or so. Played an engagement at the Savoy for two weeks. Then, after we finished the Savoy, Joe didn't have a very good booking agent. So it was really a struggle then, keeping the band together. And they started leaving, one by one, coming back to Chicago. I think Clarence Black was the first one to leave. Then Kidd Ory, and eventually Bonnie and I left. Then we…
Was he still playing pretty well then?

items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: And this is Omar Simeon. He's with Webley de Paris now in New York.

ctx.x: I showed this to Baby Dogs earlier this evening and he said it was... No, that's Logan Thomas.
And this is Omar Simeon. He's with Webley de Paris now in New York.
